state.failed.p: This does not mean nothing waits on you.
peek.label: Evidence
legend.none: No open issue (not the same as healthy)

help.reject: send the plan back / not accepted (with a reason)

brief.label: The brief for this item

story.request.draft: A draft, not yet sent for review.

rejectChange.placeholder: Why it is rejected (required; it goes to the audit log)

rejectChange.note: A rejected change ends here; doing it later takes a new request.
story.plan.steps: Show every step of this version
story.none.p: It does not exist, or you may not see it.
health.unknown: Nothing open (not the same as healthy)

world.search: Find: a name, a type, I#12
world.noneAbnormal: No resource in this range has an open issue. That is not “healthy”: nothing was found, that is all.
node.linksLlm: {n} of those relations are inferred by a model (dashed on the flat map, curved in 3D) — advisory only.
legend.llm: Dashed: a relation inferred by a model, advisory

check.bad: The picture does not match the data:
world.ties: Of the {n} items waiting on you: {ring} sit on a ringed resource, {quiet} on a resource without a ring (gone, or with nothing open), {off} on no resource of the map.
path.pick1: Pick the first resource, or search on the left.
path.pick2: From {a}. Now pick the second resource.
path.none: {a} and {b} are not linked within 8 steps.
path.caveat: This is how they are linked — not a claim that a fault travels this way.
node.gone: The latest complete scan did not list it. That is not “deleted”: it was not listed, that is all.
legend.llm3d: Curved: a relation inferred by a model — advisory
legend.flow: Running dots: the way a fault would travel
legend.schematic: Placed by account and containment, not a network topology; distance means nothing

empty.filtered.big: Nothing of this kind right now
gone.big: {ref} is not waiting on you now
gone.p: It may have been handled, or it waits on someone else.
generic.ask: handle this item. This interface has no page of its own for it yet; use the classic page.
generic.noResource: Not tied to a specific resource.
generic.open: Handle it in the classic page
ask.approve.run: approve this plan. It starts running as soon as you approve.
ask.approve.only: approve this plan. Approving only approves: nothing runs by itself afterwards; someone starts the run separately.
ask.approve.cannot: read this plan. You cannot approve it right now: {why}
ask.accept.none: look at the result of the run, then accept.
refused.forbidden: your account lacks the permission, or the requester may not approve their own request.
refused.issue_closed: the issue is closed; reopen it first.
refused.state: its current state does not allow this.
refused.no_hash: the plan has no content hash, so an approval has nothing to bind to.
refused.other: the server did not allow it ({code}).
approve.shadow: The access policy is in shadow mode: by the rules this approval would be refused; it goes through and is audited.
toast.approved.only: {ref} approved. It will not run by itself
err.partial: The verdict was saved, but the step after it failed: {msg}
sec.failedLoad: This part could not be loaded.
plan.tierNote: «Changes things / read-only» beside each command is classified by code, not stated by the model.
plan.rollback: The rollback, if it goes wrong
plan.rollback.none: This plan declares no rollback steps.
impact.note: The numbers come from the rule relations of the graph, none inferred by a model.
impact.unanchored: This item is not tied to a resource on the graph, so who it touches cannot be worked out.
impact.truncated: Too many relations: these numbers are lower bounds.
checks.none: This plan declares no checks: after the run it comes back here for your acceptance.
cause.none: This item has no diagnosis yet.
ev.grounded: Every cited piece of evidence was found in this diagnosis's own tool results.
ev.ungrounded: Some cited evidence was not found in this diagnosis's own tool results.
peek.summaryOnly: This is the summary stored at diagnosis time; the raw output was not kept.
ran.bind.match: It ran plan v{v} (hash {hash}), the content that was approved.
ran.bind.drift: It ran plan v{v} (hash {hash}); the plan's content changed after it was approved.
ran.bind.noPlan: The plan this run executed could not be loaded.
accept.none: This item has no run waiting for acceptance right now.
accept.rejectNote: Marked not accepted, the item returns to «root cause identified» and this diagnosis is marked disputed.
gate.critic: The reviewing model refuted this diagnosis, so no plan is written automatically; it needs your call.
gate.manual: This diagnosis did not go on to planning by itself; it needs your call.
verdict.ph.falsePositive: Why it is a false alarm (required)
verdict.note.rcaWrong: The diagnosis is marked incorrect and the item returns to you, where you can have it diagnosed again.
verdict.note.falsePositive: Marked a false alarm, the item is dismissed and the detection agent notes that this kind is a false alarm. It can be reopened.
ask.not_started.can: run it now, or withdraw the approval. A retry starts running at once.
ask.not_started.cannot: look at this plan: approved, never started. You cannot retry it right now: {why}
ask.rerun.missing: this item has no diagnosis yet: have the agent diagnose it.
ask.acceptChange.none: look at the result of the run, then confirm the change is complete.
ran.failed.other: Run #{run} failed after {duration}. No step reported a failure.
ran.failed.check: Run #{run} finished its steps in {duration}; a declared check then failed.
ran.failed.rejected: Run #{run} finished in {duration}; it was not accepted.
rollback.ran: The rollback ran {n} steps, all of them succeeded.
rollback.failed: The rollback ran {n} steps and {f} failed — the resource may be left half-changed.
notStarted.executor_disabled: The executor is switched off, so nothing ran this after the approval. Turn the executor on before retrying.
notStarted.generic: The run did not start after the approval: auto-fix is off, or queueing it failed.
approved.line.match: {by} approved this version at {t} UTC (hash {hash}). The content has not changed since.
approved.line.drift: {by} approved this version at {t} UTC. The plan's content changed after that: a run will be refused.
withdraw.note: Withdrawn, the plan is marked rejected and the item returns to you as «plan sent back».
cancel.note: Cancelled, this change ends here; doing it later takes a new request.
replan.note: When it redoes the plan, the agent is given the reason quoted above.
replan.noReason: No reason written by a person came with this rejection.
rerun.note: When it diagnoses again, the agent sees the earlier conclusion and what a person made of it.
sec.readyRca: A diagnosis that passed the gate; nobody has confirmed it
generate.ready: This diagnosis passed the gate for automatic planning, but auto-fix is off, so nobody asked an agent for a plan.
verdict.none: No verdict by a person is on record.
resolve.unverified: This run ended without a verification verdict (the verdict field is empty).
resolve.none: This item has no run on record.
proposed.none: The requester wrote no steps; the reviewing agent will.
clarify.free: The review lists no specific question. Write what should be added:
clarify.note: Your answers go to the reviewing agent as one message; it then reviews again.
plan.diffNote: Against the requester's own steps: {added} added, {modified} changed, {removed} dropped, {unchanged} the same.
plan.none: This change has no implementation plan to approve right now.
approve.reason.ph: Why you approve (required; kept on the change)
approve.reason.label: Reason for approving
approve.reason.need: Write the reason first, then hold to approve.
failChange.note: Marked failed, this change ends as failed; a redo is a new request.
atwork.rca: An agent is diagnosing this item (started {t} ago{by}). No need to ask again before it ends.
atwork.sre: An agent is writing a plan for this item (started {t} ago{by}). No need to ask again before it ends.
atwork.review: An agent is reviewing this change (started {t} ago).
err.inFlight: An agent is already working on this item; wait for it to finish.
feed.none: No agent is working right now.
feed.failed: Agent activity could not be loaded.
story.failed.p: The record of this item could not be loaded. That does not mean it does not exist.
story.rca.needsCall: The second model refuted this diagnosis, so no plan was written by itself; it waits for a person's call.
story.plan.summary.tiers: {label} v{v}　{hash}　{n} steps, {w} of them change things.
story.plan.rejected: This version was sent back by {by}.
story.approve.person: It waits for someone who may approve it.
story.run.notStarted: Approved, but the run did not start.
story.accept.need: This run waits for a person's acceptance: {reason}
story.accept.needPlain: This run waits for a person's acceptance.
story.accept.passed: Every declared check passed; it waits to be marked resolved.
story.accept.noVerdict: The run left no verification verdict; it waits for a person to confirm.
story.dismissed: This item was dismissed. New signals from the same source merge into it without alerting; it can be reopened.
story.change.review.stuck: The review stopped on the {n} questions below; it waits for the requester's answers.
story.change.closed.rejected: This change was rejected and ends here.
story.change.closed.cancelled: This change was cancelled and ends here.
help.story: the item's whole story; on that page: go decide
wait.agentIdle: It is an agent's turn; nothing on record says one has started
story.ask.approve: Approve this plan, or send it back.
story.ask.accept: Look at the checks, then accept the result or turn it down.
story.ask.confirm: Judge whether this diagnosis is right.
story.ask.generate: Have an agent write the fix plan.
story.ask.replan: Have an agent redo the plan that was sent back.
story.ask.failed: The run failed: decide between a new plan and a new diagnosis.
story.ask.not_started: Approved, but the run never started: retry it, or withdraw the approval.
story.ask.start_review: Hand this change request to an agent for review.
story.ask.generic: Look at it and decide the next step.
story.scopeMoved: The account scope is now “{name}”: this item belongs to that account.
story.found.seen: The same signal was seen {n} times; all are merged into this item.
story.rca.belowGate: The model's own confidence, {conf}, is below the auto-fix gate of {gate}, so no plan was written by itself; it waits for a person's call.
story.plan.unclear: The code cannot classify, or refuses, the command of {u} more.
story.plan.count: This item has had {n} plans; this is the newest.
story.run.checking: Approved; checking whether the run has started.
story.run.started: The run started at {t} UTC and has not ended.
story.change.review.stuckPlain: The review needs clarification; it waits for the requester's answer.
plan.basis.older: This plan was written from an earlier diagnosis, not the current one.
plan.basis.rewritten: This plan's record was created at {t} UTC, before the diagnosis it is based on: it was rewritten since.
live.honest: What is listed here is state the server can check. Open a lane to see the agent's steps — recorded by the code as they happen, fetched every 3 seconds.
live.failed.p: That does not mean no agent is at work.
live.gone.big: This lane is no longer listed
live.gone.p: It has ended, or it is more than a day old. What it left behind is not known to this page — the item's story has the record.
live.moved: It has ended. This is what it left behind.
live.basis.requested: On the server's record: {who} asked for it, and this process is still on it.
live.basis.run: On the server's record: a run row is pending or running.
live.basis.status: Known from the item's status; the back end records nothing finer.
live.basis.event: Known from the timeline: the run started and no end is on record.
live.basis.schedule: On the server's record: a run of this schedule is in progress.
live.basis.build: On the server's record: this graph build is in progress.
live.overdue: It has outlived its own time limit and may be stuck.
live.plan.none: The plan it is running was not found.
live.result.none: This run's record was not found.
live.result.newerRca: The item has a newer diagnosis since; this is the newest one.
live.group.stalled: Stalled: no agent is on it
live.basis.stopped: The item's status still waits for a diagnosis, but the last one left no result: it ended, or it ran far past its time limit and never ended. No agent is on it now.
live.stopped.next: It waits on a person: from Decide the agent can be asked to diagnose it again, or the item dismissed. Its story page has the whole record.
story.rca.stopped: The last diagnosis ended at {t} UTC and left no result; the status stayed “investigating”, and no agent is on it now.
story.rca.stopped.unknown: The last diagnosis ended and left no result; the status stayed “investigating”, and no agent is on it now.

world.ties.unknown: The items waiting on you could not be fetched, so nothing is said here about where they are on the map.
world.stale: The newest graph could not be fetched. The picture is from {t} UTC.

check.dropped: {n} more have an end that is not in this build; they are not drawn.
check.fresh.unknown: The relations are those of build {id} (no finish time on record); what changed since is not on the map.
node.gone.open: The latest complete scan did not list it, yet an issue is still open on it. It wears no ring; the issue is below.
world.ties.readOnly: This is a read-only account: nothing is ever handed to you, so the map is not tied to a queue here.
world.ties.none: Nothing is waiting on you right now.
legend.flow3d: Running dots: the way a fault would travel (none on a two-way relation)
help.cmd: the command bar: / for commands, @ for things (also Cmd / Ctrl + K)
live.basis.pipeline: On the server's record: the diagnosis passed its gate, the pipeline handed the item to the plan-writing agent, and this process is still on it.
brief.changed: {ref} just changed; this page now shows it as it is.
gone.elsewhere.big: {ref} waits on you, but not in this list
gone.elsewhere.filter: It is waiting as another kind of decision, outside the filter you picked.
gone.elsewhere.scope: It belongs to another account than the scope picked in the top bar.
err.refused: The server did not accept it: {msg} This page has been read again.
err.rcaChanged: The diagnosis has been replaced by a newer one, so this verdict was not recorded. The page now shows the newest diagnosis — read it, then judge.
ask.approve.unknown: approve this plan. Whether it runs right after the approval is decided by the server's settings — this page was not told.
toast.approved.unknown: {ref} approved. Whether its run has started: see its story
resolve.final: «Resolved» is final and cannot be reopened — so the key is held.
clarify.tooLong: The answers together are {n} characters too long to send: please shorten them
replan.byCode: This plan was withdrawn by code, not sent back by a person ({t} UTC): {reason}. Nobody wrote feedback, and the agent asked for the next plan is given none.
plan.rawStep: This step is not written as “what it does + command”; it is shown above as it is.
checks.preNote: Checked before anything runs; the approval covers these too:
plan.basis.rewrittenAt: This plan's record was created at {t} UTC, before the diagnosis it is based on: it was rewritten at {at} UTC.
story.resolved.from: It was marked resolved straight from “{from}”; the steps it never took are marked “not taken” above.
wait.agentOverdue: The record shows an agent started and never ended, past its own time limit — most likely nothing is working on it any more
atwork.overdue.rca: On record this diagnosis began {t} ago and has not ended; it is past its own time limit — most likely no agent is on it any more. You can ask again; the old run is then recorded as abandoned.
atwork.overdue.sre: On record this plan run began {t} ago and has not ended; it is past its own time limit — most likely no agent is on it any more. You can ask again; the old run is then recorded as abandoned.
atwork.overdue.review: The record shows this review started {t} ago and no end, past its own time limit. Most likely no agent is working on it any more.
live.ended.big: This lane ended, and nothing it left behind is listed
live.ended.p: Nothing made since it began is under «ended in the last day»: it may have failed, or only rewritten an existing plan. The item's story has its record.
live.cut.work: Agent work: the newest {shown} of {total} in the last day.
live.cut.schedules: Schedule runs: the newest {shown} of {total} in the last day.
world.selMissing: The resource in the address ({id}) is not on this build's map; this is the whole map.
world.goneOpen: {n} more resources that are gone still have an open issue: hollow on the map, no ring, not in the list above.
check.containExtra: {n} more containment relations go to a second or later holder of a resource: such a resource is drawn inside the circle of its lowest-id holder, and its other holders show as lines only when it is selected.
check.health: Health and “gone” were read at {t} UTC; they are read again every 30 seconds while the page is open, and after a decision.
check.health.unknown: When health and “gone” were read is not on record.
check.newerFailed: A newer build (build {id}, {t} UTC) failed; the map is still the one named above.
check.culled: Off the screen and not drawn: {nodes} of the {total} resources, {rings} rings, {links} lines.
check.scope: The check is on counts: what is on the canvas plus what is left out off the screen, against the data. It does not check colours or positions.
node.byId: {n} more open issues carry the same resource id in their alarm but are not confirmed to be on this resource (not counted in the health above):
node.asOf.unknown: When this health was read is not on record.
path.inferred: Inferred by a model: {n} of these links — advisory; no route over rule relations alone exists within 8 steps.
legend.gone3d: Fainter dot: a resource no longer there
verdict.cut: … (the record kept only the first 200 characters of this)
live.noSteer: A run follows the version that was approved: its steps cannot be changed midway, only stopped. After a stop the command in progress finishes, no further step of the plan runs, and the executor may run only this plan's own rollback steps and read-only checks.
live.stoppingNote: {who} stopped this run at {t} UTC. The command in progress cannot be cut halfway; once it is done every further step of the plan is refused, and the executor may run only this plan's rollback steps and read-only checks. Whether the rollback ran is what its result will say when it ends.
toast.stopAsked: {ref}: stop requested — it stops after the command in progress and may then only roll back
stop.notRunning: This run has already ended; there is nothing to stop.
stop.already: Someone has already stopped this run.
ask.stopped: {who} stopped this run. Decide what is next: a new plan, or a new diagnosis.
ran.stopped: {who} stopped run #{run} at {t} UTC, {duration} in. {n} steps had reported done by then.
ran.stopped.noSteps: {who} stopped run #{run} at {t} UTC, {duration} in. The executor left no per-step results.
rollback.none.stopped: No rollback is on record: the {n} steps that had reported done before the stop were not undone.
rollback.none.stoppedClean: No rollback is on record; no step had reported done before the stop either.
rollback.none.stoppedUnknown: No rollback is on record. The executor itself left no per-step results; what it actually ran is under «Every step, as the code recorded it».
run.stopped.late: {who} asked it to stop at {t} UTC; the run was still recorded as a success.
help.live: live: a run in progress — hold to stop & roll back
steps.title: Step by step
steps.title.ended: How it got there, step by step
steps.since: This run began at {t} UTC; the code has recorded {n} steps.
steps.tally: {acts} of its commands are not read-only; {verbatim} of those are word for word a command of the plan.
steps.tally.refused: {n} were refused and did not run.
steps.none.live: No step of this run is on record yet.
steps.none.ended: There is no step-by-step record of this run: it ended before steps were recorded, or the record could not be written.
steps.you.waiting: the agent reads it before its next thought
steps.legend: ◆ a fact the code fetched　▸ something the agent did　◇ the model's own words. Each line was recorded by the code as it happened, not reported by the agent afterwards.
steps.recorded: Every step, as the code recorded it
live.plan.marks: The marks beside the steps come from the record below: a step counts only when the command that is word for word its own has run. A step the executor ran in other words is not matched here.
live.review.readonly: A review only reads; it changes nothing.
stop.rollback.none: This plan's rollback is not written as commands: a stop is not followed by any automatic rollback, and what has been done is left for a person.
stop.rollback.rewrite: This plan's rollback has {n} commands, but none can run exactly as written (several chained on one line, or a placeholder). After a stop a command the executor rewrites is refused — there will be no automatic rollback.
stop.rollback.all: After a stop the executor can run this plan's {n} rollback commands exactly as written.
stop.rollback.some: After a stop the executor can run {n} of this plan's rollback commands exactly as written; the other {rest} cannot (chained on one line, or a placeholder) and are refused once rewritten.
ask.rerun.stopped: The last diagnosis left no result: have the agent diagnose it again, or dismiss the item.
rerun.stopped: The last diagnosis left no result — it failed, ran past its time limit, or began and never ended. It has stood here since {t} UTC; no agent is on this item now, and it will not move by itself.
gone.agent.p: An agent is working on it ({what}). If it needs you once that is done, it comes back here.
steer.label: A word for the agent
steer.note: You can add a word for it (press E). It reads it before its next thought; the note is added information — it changes neither the agent's task nor what it may do — and it stays in this run's record.
steer.notRunning: It has ended; the note was not delivered.
steer.sent: {ref}: noted — the agent reads it before its next thought
help.steer: live: add a word for an agent that is diagnosing, planning or reviewing
